meta.name: git-master
meta.description: MUST USE for ANY git operations. Atomic commits, rebase/squash, history search (blame, bisect, log -S). STRONGLY RECOMMENDED: Use with task(category='quick', load_skills=['git-master'], ...) to save context. Triggers: 'commit', 'rebase', 'squash', 'who wrote', 'when was X added', 'find the commit that'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 执行 git 提交、整理提交记录与搜索历史
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果管理代码提交、整理提交记录或追溯历史修改是你的日常。
copy.tagline_en: Commit code, organize commit history, and search past changes
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often commit code, organize commit history, or search past changes.

howto.what: 装上后处理 git 请求时，它会先检查变更和分支，再把不同模块/用途的改动拆成多次小提交，测试跟实现放在同一提交，并按仓库风格写提交说明；需要时也会改写历史或查改动来历。
howto.when: 当你说出 commit、rebase、squash 等 git 指令，或询问某段代码是谁写的、何时加的时接管。

say.text: 把这几个文件的改动拆成独立的小 commit，按模块分组提交。
say.note: 会先输出提交计划，再分组执行提交。

say.text: 把最近三个 commit 压缩成一个，提交信息沿用仓库现有的风格。
say.note: 进入 rebase/历史重写，会先检查是否已推送并提醒。

say.text: 帮我查这段代码是在哪个 commit、被谁加的，什么时候加的。
say.note: 触发历史搜索，输出相关提交信息。

howto.what_en: On git requests, it inspects current state/history, splits files into several focused commits (tests stay with code), mimics repo message style, rewrites history, and traces when/who introduced a change.
howto.when_en: It is triggered by git-related requests such as saying 'commit', 'rebase', 'squash', or asking who/when a piece of code was added.

say_en.text: Split these changed files into separate small commits by logical module.
say_en.note: Enters commit mode, prints the plan, then commits per group.

say_en.text: Squash the last three commits into one, matching the repo's message style.
say_en.note: Runs history rewrite; warns if already pushed.

say_en.text: Trace which commit introduced this code, by whom, and when.
say_en.note: History search returns the matching commits.
